name: zvideo_pixel_pack_setup_from_masks
description: zVideo::PixelPack_SetupFromMasks initializes the RGB pixel-pack masks, bit counts, packed shifts, and 8-bit shifted masks from DirectDraw pixel-format channel widths.
known_limits: Current VC5SP3 11.00.7022 /O2 /Ob1 /Zp4 COFF byte compare fails with 109 unmasked mismatches after masking 48 relocation bytes; Binary Ninja body is 166 bytes and the VC object body is 176 bytes with 9 trailing VC NOPs trimmed.
The reviewed failure is broader store scheduling and inline shifted-mask expression drift in the display pixel-pack setup body, not a one-byte addressing-mode-only mismatch.

A same-session rBits-before-packed-shifts source-order variant and a direct-global-write variant were both byte-neutral at 109 unmasked mismatches with 48 relocation-masked bytes and 9 trimmed VC NOPs, so the source body was restored.
A same-session explicit BN-like temporary sequence worsened the compare to 113 unmasked mismatches with 48 relocation-masked bytes and 13 trimmed VC NOPs, so the source body was restored.

A same-session variant moving the greenBits-plus-blueBits source expression below the three mask stores worsened the compare to 115 unmasked mismatches with 48 relocation-masked bytes and 12 trimmed VC NOPs, so the source body was restored.

A delayed redMaskShifted computation plus blueBits-plus-greenBits source spelling preserved functional behavior but was byte-neutral at 109 unmasked mismatches with 48 relocation-masked bytes and 9 trimmed VC NOPs, so the source body was restored.
The native smoke verifies 5:6:5 RGB masks, bit counts, packed red/green/blue shift state, and shifted 8-bit masks written to the global zVideo pixel-pack state.
